notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Boo! It's Halloween season again, and you know what that means:
The return of the [b]Super Treasure Arena Halloween Edition[/b]!

For the next 2 weeks, enjoy decorated maps and fight for delicious candy - again!
Happy Halloween! :)

notes.title: Update 0.10.0 - Progression and Gameplay
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I've been working on a bigger update for quite a while, but since that is taking longer than expected, I decided to split the update and release some of the changes right now! Please enjoy :)

[h1]Patch Nodes v0.10.0[/h1]

[b]General[/b]

- [b]New progression system[/b]: Players now gain experience points from online matches, based on their performance
- Inactive players will now automatically be removed from online lobbies

[b]Gameplay[/b]

- [b]New mechanic[/b]: You can now dodge attacks in any direction by pressing the jump button while blocking! This can also be used to move around more quickly.
- Stamina recovery kicks in faster, reducing downtime between actions
- Running out of stamina now greatly reduces movement speed until recovered
- Small potions now restore more health (raised from 10 to 15)
- Some Minions will now use projectile weapons
- Attack speed of Minions has been lowered significantly, making dodging and blocking more effective
- Minions can no longer aggro through solid objects
- Heroes with a timed special ability can no longer block while their ability is active

[b]UI[/b]

- Added result screen after online matches to show more details about the player's in-game performance
- Button prompts in menus have been scaled down
- Fixed some overlapping UI elements in menus

For a list of all Patch Notes, visit this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/338330/discussions/0/343786746016381051/]Forum Thread[/url]

notes.title: Update 0.9.0 - Map Updates
notes.notes:
Hello!

Before adding more content in future updates, I wanted to make sure each of the existing maps has a unique feel to it. So in this update, some maps received an overhaul. Hope you enjoy! :)

[h1]Patch Notes v0.9.0[/h1]

[b]General[/b]

- Revamped "Cove", featuring a new tileset and enemy type
- Slightly changed the layout of "Cove" in "Classic" mode
- Updated "Glade" to give it a more unique atmosphere
- Slightly updated "Hideout"

[b]UI[/b]

- Updated slides in map selection screen

[b]Misc[/b]

- The global stat ticker is now hidden when playing offline
- Minor performace improvements and reduced memory usage

notes.title: Update 0.8.0 - Leaderboards and Global Stats
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Time for another update! This time, it's all about comparing your scores and showing game statistics. Read below to find out what's new, and thanks again for your feedback! :)

[h1]Patch Notes v0.8.0[/h1]

[b]General[/b]

- Added Online Leaderboards, allowing to compare scores to friends and top players
- Players are now able to chat while waiting to respawn
- Players are now able to chat during character selection and in the result screen
- Maps shuffle more equally in online lobbies
- The same map will no longer play twice in a row when playing online

[b]UI[/b]

- Added global stats ticker to most menu screens
- The button prompt to invite friends during character selection does now show properly

[b]Misc[/b]

- Fixed some stats not updating properly
- Minor fixes

notes.title: Update 0.7.0 - Matchmaking and More
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The first update is live! Read below to find out what's new. Thanks everyone for your feedback over the last couple of days! :)

[h1]Patch Notes v0.7.0[/h1]

It should now be easier for players to find each other online.

Instead of being thrown into an empty lobby when all other lobbies are currently in a match, players can now enter a queue and will join once the match is over.
Bots now also count as free slots for players to join, and players will automatically replace any bot if necessary.

[b]General[/b]

- Fixed an issue that prevented players from interacting with certain objects or completing a match if Steam Services were unavailable
- Fixed an issue where treasure chests in "Treasure Run" could be pushed by players under special conditions
- Playing a match without other players or bots does not count towards achievement progress anymore

[b]UI[/b]

- The current server region is now correctly displayed in the top right corner when invited by another player
- Trying to connect to servers when Steam Services and/or the Steam Client is offline, now displays an error message, instead of failing silently

[b]Gameplay[/b]

- Slightly increased cast time of Mystic's special ability (from 0.5s to 0.6s)
- Slightly decreased duration of Mystic's ice spell (from 3.0s to 2.5s)
